note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type DELAY, label تأجيل. Lead from the Grok digest 17:29 Dubai (a lead, not a source); verified against the primary: Bandai Namco's official Gekishin Squadra notice dated 4 Nov 2026 (dbg-squadra.bn-ent.net/en-us/news/ax8v0tn_jq): major overhaul 'originally scheduled for the end of 2026 has been postponed to March 2027', reason: polish, bug fixes, stability; promises new emotes and Star Collection additions (Super Saiyan God SS Son Goku), regular patches beyond the planned weekly period; event schedules soon. Platforms not stated in the notice (PC, PS5, PS4, Switch, mobile per launch coverage); TheGamer says replies are mostly negative (not used). Hook: the big Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra overhaul slips to March 2027. Why now: notice 4 Nov. Players here: Dragon Ball's Gulf audience, free to play on PC, consoles and mobile. Payoff: more patches meanwhile. Old date: end of 2026; new date: March 2027; reason given. Footage route: Steam app 2072560 official trailer from 12 s (shots judged on the render sheet), stand-in game footage named on screen; sound the trailer's own. picture: Gekishin Squadra Steam trailer 12 to 30.2 s. Names: Bandai Namco bracketed. Sensitive: none.
